skill.name: webapp-testing
skill.usageExample: 帮我测试这个网页，重点看看登录、搜索、提交表单和手机上显示是否正常，并把发现的问题截图整理出来。

description.zh: 使用 Playwright 与本地 Web 应用交互并测试的工具箱：验证前端功能、调试 UI 行为、截取浏览器截图、查看浏览器日志。
description.en: Toolkit for interacting with and testing local web applications using Playwright. Supports verifying frontend functionality, debugging UI behavior, capturing browser screenshots, and viewing browser logs.
